title: Oklahoma 59, West Virginia 31: Rodney Anderson's Four Scores
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. West Virginia on November 25, 2017?
answer: Oklahoma beat West Virginia 59-31 in Norman on November 25, 2017, after leading 45-10 at halftime. Running back Rodney Anderson rushed for 118 yards and four touchdowns.
summary: On Nov. 25, 2017, Oklahoma routed West Virginia 59-31 in Norman, leading 45-10 at the half behind four Rodney Anderson touchdowns and a 66-yard Kyler Murray run.
body: The 2017 regular-season finale for Oklahoma came on Saturday, November 25, at Gaylord Family Oklahoma Memorial Stadium. The Sooners entered ranked third by the AP and fourth in the College Football Playoff rankings, with a Big 12 Championship Game date against TCU waiting the following week.

The game was effectively decided before halftime. Kyler Murray took the opening snap and raced 66 yards on the first play from scrimmage, and Rodney Anderson scored soon after. Oklahoma kept scoring and went to the locker room ahead 45-10.

Anderson was the star of the day, finishing with 118 rushing yards and four rushing touchdowns. Baker Mayfield was sharp through the air, throwing for 281 yards and three touchdowns, including 238 yards and two scores on 11-of-12 passing by halftime.
West Virginia scored late to make the final margin look closer, and the Mountaineers headed to a bowl game afterward, while Oklahoma turned its attention to TCU and the Big 12 title game.
It was a loud, fast, high-scoring way to close a Norman regular season, and a reminder of how explosive that 2017 offense could be when everything clicked.
